metaTitle: How to Choose and Rig a Camping Tarp
description: Choose a camping tarp by size, fabric and weight, then rig it with the right knots and pitches for rain, sun and wind. Includes sizing table.
directAnswer: Choose a tarp by size and fabric: 10 by 10 feet covers a small table, polyethylene is cheap and heavy, and coated nylon or polyester is light. Rig it taut with a slope so water runs off, using taut-line and bowline knots.
